blocks.html: The filters to apply on the retrieved product variants.

types.name: $and
types.description: An array of filters to apply on the entity, where each item in the array is joined with an "and" condition.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

children.name: limit
children.description: The maximum number of items to retrieve.

children.name: offset
children.description: The number of items to skip before retrieving the returned items.

children.name: order
children.description: The field to sort by and in which order.

children.name: with_deleted
children.description: Whether to include soft-deleted items in the results.

children.name: q
children.description: Query or keywords to filter the variant's searchable fields.

children.name: id
children.description: Filter by variant ID(s).

children.name: options
children.description: Apply filters on the variant's options.

children.name: created_at
children.description: Apply filters on the variant's creation date.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: Apply filters on the variant's update date.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: Apply filters on the variant's deletion date.
